Instructions for Use
Device description: The Cobalt Cochlear Implant is a cochlear implant. It is available in lengths from 8 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
The Cobalt Cochlear Implant is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5-Tesla and 3-Tesla
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 25 T/m
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg
Head SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg
Device Configuration MRI mode ON
Scan Regions Extremity scanning only (knee and below, elbow and below)
MR image artifact: the artifact may extend up to 2 mm beyond the implant.
